analysis:
The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md. The patch hunk is at head lines 2966-2970 and adds documentation that a cluster re-plan after an update waits until both Macs report the same worker build (ClusterOnboardingUpdate.oneBuild), with a link to the pair's coordinated update. No source code, wire protocol, key handling, attestation, authorization, encryption or cache-storage behavior changes.

The supplied units are the base excerpt at lines 5337-5432 and the head excerpt at lines 1-419. Neither contains the changed hunk, so the new text itself was reviewed only from the patch excerpt. The surrounding material is unchanged descriptive prose about Qwen TP assistants, cluster stop ordering, capacity, Nemotron media and cluster setup. None of it alters security controls, and I saw nothing in it that conflicts with the threat model. I checked it against T-041 (prefix cache), TB-007, TB-002, TB-003 and the A-001, A-003 and A-004 assets.

The described build-equality gate is a liveness and consistency improvement, not a trust decision. The threat model does not make it an authorization boundary: worker pinning and served-record binding were already documented. The referenced doc ../provider/cluster-always-on.md and the implementation of ClusterOnboardingUpdate.oneBuild are not in the supplied evidence. I therefore cannot confirm that the doc matches the code. That is a documentation-accuracy question with no security conclusion attached, so I raise no finding and do not request deeper review.
